mapper.sql: SELECT id, app_id AS appId, app_secret AS appSecret, open_id AS openId, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_avatar_url AS recipientAvatarUrl, enabled FROM news_feishu_notification_setting WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news_feishu_notification_setting (id, app_id, app_secret, open_id, recipient_name, recipient_avatar_url, enabled) VALUES (1, #{appId}, #{appSecret}, #{openId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientAvatarUrl}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_id = #{appId}, app_secret = #{appSecret}, open_id = #{openId}, recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_avatar_url = #{recipientAvatarUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}
mapper.select: SELECT revision, config_json AS configJson FROM news_feishu_channel_config WHERE id = 1
SELECT revision, config_json AS configJson FROM news_feishu_channel_config WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE news_feishu_channel_config SET revision = revision + 1, config_json = #{configJson} WHERE id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT app_id, open_id, name, avatar_url FROM news_feishu_authorized_user WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY name, open_id
